title: Someone requests confidential information
summary: A low-drama response for pausing disclosure, verifying need and authority, and recording sensitive-information decisions.
contentNotice: Demonstration playbook for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy and must be reviewed before operational use.
scenario: Use this when a supplier, contractor, candidate, team member or external party asks for information that may be commercially sensitive, personal, restricted or outside their usual access.
immediateAction: Do not disclose the information while authority or purpose is unclear.
Clarify exactly what is being requested, why it is needed and who will receive it.
Route the request to the information owner or Founder when the permission basis is not already established.

whoToInform.when: Before any restricted information is shared.
For commercially sensitive, strategic, financial or exceptional disclosures.

whatToRecord: What was ultimately shared, if anything
escalationConditions: The requester pressures for immediate disclosure without a clear need.
The request includes financial, strategic, personal or access-control information.
There is doubt about recipient identity, forwarding risk or contractual confidentiality.

templatesResources.label: Holding reply
templatesResources.text: Acknowledge the request, explain that access must be verified internally, and give a realistic time for a response without implying approval.
